name: agarzon
description: Personal Claude Code skills and workflow extensions.

showGitRow.title: Show: git row
showGitRow.description: The band row with the branch, uncommitted changes, worktree, open PR/MR (gh for GitHub, glab otherwise), folder, Claude Code version and session time.

showPromptRail.title: Show: prompt rail
showPromptRail.description: The row of numbered prompts above the band; click one to jump to it.

showModelButtons.title: Show: model and effort buttons
showModelButtons.description: The band buttons that switch model and effort for this session. Off, requests go out unchanged.

showUsageLimits.title: Show: 5h/7d usage
showUsageLimits.description: The 5-hour and 7-day usage in the band.

showContext.title: Show: context meter
showContext.description: The context size, bar and handoff button in the band.

showCache.title: Show: cache timer
showCache.description: The prompt-cache timer in the band.

showLoadedSkills.title: Show: skills chip
showLoadedSkills.description: The `skills N · Xk` chip in the band: skills now in context and their size, red when one is in context twice.

showSoundButton.title: Show: sound button
showSoundButton.description: The ♪ in the band: click mutes or unmutes all sounds. Per-sound toggles: /sounds.

showSidebarButton.title: Sidebar button
showSidebarButton.description: A ☰ button in the band (and /panel) that opens the Git, Context, Agents, Cache and Sounds tabs beside the transcript. Left open, they reopen in the next session.

skillGuard.title: Skill guard
skillGuard.description: In the main conversation: a toast when a skill of 8k tokens or more loads, and a second load of a skill still in context (a typed /skill, or any load after --resume, which Claude Code re-sends in full) is replaced by a one-line pointer to the first copy.

hideDeniedSkills.title: Hide denied skills
hideDeniedSkills.description: Skills your settings deny with a Skill(...) rule in permissions.deny are left out of the skill list Claude reads each session, saving its tokens. They could not run anyway.

guardColdSend.title: Cold-send guard
guardColdSend.description: When the prompt cache has gone cold, hold back your next typed prompt once and say what re-caching costs; Enter again sends it. Prompts you did not type are never held back.

guardColdSendMinK.title: Cold-send guard from (k tokens)
guardColdSendMinK.description: The guard holds a prompt back only when the context is at least this many thousand tokens.

keepWarm.title: Keep-warm
keepWarm.description: Offers the warm button and /warm, which ping the prompt cache while you are away so it does not expire. Never on by itself.

keepWarmAfterMin.title: Keep-warm ping after (minutes idle)
keepWarmAfterMin.description: Keep-warm pings once the conversation has been idle this long. The 1-hour cache leaves this much margin: 45 gives 15 minutes for a slow or retried ping.

autoHandoff.title: Auto-handoff
autoHandoff.description: When the conversation sits idle until 5 minutes before the prompt cache expires, run /agarzon:handoff by itself, with a 1-minute warning. Permission prompts during that turn are declined. Keep-warm, when on, pings first, so this never fires.

contextLimitK.title: Context limit (k tokens)
contextLimitK.description: At this many thousand tokens of context the band turns red, a handoff button appears and the context-limit sound plays. Yellow from half of it.

limitOrangePercent.title: 5h/7d orange at projected %
limitOrangePercent.description: The 5h and 7d usage turns orange when the usage projected at the window reset reaches this percent.

limitRedPercent.title: 5h/7d red at projected %
limitRedPercent.description: The 5h and 7d usage turns red, and shows when it hits 100%, when the usage projected at the window reset reaches this percent.

turnSoundSeconds.title: Turn-done sound after (seconds)
turnSoundSeconds.description: Play the turn-done sound only for main-thread turns at least this long.

soundTurnDone.title: Sound: turn done
soundTurnDone.description: A bundled sound name (glass-003, question-001, drop-001, back-001, error-002, error-005), an absolute path to a .wav file, or empty for silence.

soundNeedsYou.title: Sound: needs you
soundNeedsYou.description: A bundled sound name (glass-003, question-001, drop-001, back-001, error-002, error-005), an absolute path to a .wav file, or empty for silence.

soundSubagentDone.title: Sound: subagent finished
soundSubagentDone.description: A bundled sound name (glass-003, question-001, drop-001, back-001, error-002, error-005), an absolute path to a .wav file, or empty for silence.

soundCacheExpiring.title: Sound: cache expiring
soundCacheExpiring.description: A bundled sound name (glass-003, question-001, drop-001, back-001, error-002, error-005), an absolute path to a .wav file, or empty for silence.

soundContextLimit.title: Sound: context limit
soundContextLimit.description: A bundled sound name (glass-003, question-001, drop-001, back-001, error-002, error-005), an absolute path to a .wav file, or empty for silence.

soundCacheCold.title: Sound: cache cold
soundCacheCold.description: A bundled sound name (glass-003, question-001, drop-001, back-001, error-002, error-005), an absolute path to a .wav file, or empty for silence.

holdRiskyCommands.title: Hold risky commands
holdRiskyCommands.description: Before a risky Bash command runs (recursive rm, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, git branch -D, migrations, SQL DROP/TRUNCATE, docker prune, cloud deletes), ask with a read-only preview of what it would touch. Catches mistakes; it is not a security boundary.
